script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: small-town life

Begin screenplay.

Title: ECHOES OF THE FORGOTTEN

INT. SILENT HILL TRUCK - DAY

Rain pelts the windshield of the old pickup truck as JENNY, a young woman in her late 20s, clutches the steering wheel. The radio crackles with static as her eyes remain fixed on the narrow road ahead.

JENNY
(to herself)
Why did I agree to this?

INT. SILENT HILL - MAIN STREET - DAY

Jenny parks her truck near the town sign of Silent Hill. She steps out and takes a deep breath of the damp, earthy air. The small town, shrouded in fog, seems deserted.

JENNY
(to herself)
This is a mistake.

INT. SILENT HILL POLICE DEPARTMENT - DAY

Jenny enters the dimly lit police station and approaches DESK SGT. CARTER. He looks up from his desk with a surprised expression.

JENNY
I'm here to see the mayor. I've been contacted by the Silent Hill Preservation Society. They mentioned that the town was in need of assistance.

Desk Sgt. Carter raises an eyebrow, skeptical.

DESK SGT. CARTER
The town's fine. You've been misinformed.

JENNY
I've come prepared to help, regardless. I'll stay in the local inn and I'll start my work tomorrow.

INT. SILENT HILL INN - LOBBY - NIGHT

Jenny enters the old inn and checks in with the OWNER, a kindly older woman named MRS. DALTON. She hands Jenny a key to her room and invites her to join the townspeople for dinner in the dining room.

INT. SILENT HILL INN - DINING ROOM - NIGHT

Jenny sits at a table with various townspeople, including the MAYOR, MRS. SILVA, and HENRY, the local doctor. They engage in polite conversation, but Jenny notices an underlying tension in their interactions.

MAYOR
(to Henry)
I've asked you to keep an eye on things, Henry. I don't like the way things have been going.

HENRY
(sighs)
I'll do what I can, Mayor.

INT. SILENT HILL - ABANDONED FACTORY - NIGHT

Jenny explores the abandoned factory on the outskirts of town, intrigued by the strange whispers and echoes she hears. She comes across a large, ancient machine, its gears still turning slowly. Suddenly, the machine springs to life, revealing itself to be a sentient being.

SENTIENT MACHINE
You seek to help our town? Very well. I will show you the truth.

INT. SILENT HILL - TOWN SQUARE - DAY

Jenny, accompanied by the sentient machine, discovers a hidden underground laboratory beneath the town square. Here, she learns of the dark history of Silent Hill: a centuries-old experiment gone wrong, which has cursed the town with supernatural phenomena.

JENNY
(shocked)
This is beyond my capabilities. I cannot fix this alone.

SENTIENT MACHINE
Then seek out those who can.

INT. SILENT HILL POLICE DEPARTMENT - DAY

Jenny returns to the police station and shares her discovery with Desk Sgt. Carter. He is initially skeptical but eventually agrees to help her rally the townspeople to uncover the truth and put an end to the curse.

INT. SILENT HILL - TOWN HALL - NIGHT

Jenny and Desk Sgt. Carter address the townspeople, revealing the truth about the town's history and the curse that plagues it. They vow to work together to put an end to the supernatural phenomena and restore Silent Hill to its former glory.

EXT. SILENT HILL - TOWN - NIGHT

The townspeople, united, begin to repair the damage caused by the curse. They work together, determined to put their town back together, piece by piece.

INT. SILENT HILL INN - LOBBY - MORNING

Jenny, tired but content, sits in the inn lobby, watching the sun rise over the foggy town. She knows her work is far from over, but she is hopeful for the future of Silent Hill.

Fade out.

End of screenplay.
